<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0a0a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
canvas{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const W=480,H=480,C=24,COLS=W/C,ROWS=H/C;
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;

let snake,dir,nextDir,food,score,best=0,state,tick,elapsed,speed;

function init(){
  snake=[{x:10,y:10},{x:9,y:10},{x:8,y:10}];
  dir={x:1,y:0};nextDir={x:1,y:0};
  score=0;speed=110;elapsed=0;state='play';
  placeFood();
}

function placeFood(){
  let open=[];
  for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++)for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++){
    if(!snake.some(s=>s.x===x&&s.y===y))open.push({x,y});
  }
  food=open[Math.random()*open.length|0];
}

function update(){
  dir=nextDir;
  let head={x:snake[0].x+dir.x,y:snake[0].y+dir.y};
  if(head.x<0||head.x>=COLS||head.y<0||head.y>=ROWS||
     snake.some(s=>s.x===head.x&&s.y===head.y)){
    state='over';best=Math.max(best,score);return;
  }
  snake.unshift(head);
  if(head.x===food.x&&head.y===food.y){
    score++;speed=Math.max(55,110-score*2);
    placeFood();
  }else{snake.pop()}
}

function draw(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0d1117';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // subtle grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='#161b22';ctx.lineWidth=0.5;
  for(let i=1;i<COLS;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i*C,0);ctx.lineTo(i*C,H);ctx.stroke()}
  for(let i=1;i<ROWS;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,i*C);ctx.lineTo(W,i*C);ctx.stroke()}

  // food glow
  let pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(Date.now()*0.006);
  let grd=ctx.createRadialGradient(food.x*C+C/2,food.y*C+C/2,2,food.x*C+C/2,food.y*C+C/2,C*1.2);
  grd.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,107,53,${0.18*pulse})`);grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,107,53,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fillRect(food.x*C-C,food.y*C-C,C*3,C*3);

  // food
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff6b35';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(food.x*C+C/2,food.y*C+C/2,C/2-3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  // snake
  snake.forEach((s,i)=>{
    let t=1-i/snake.length;
    let r=Math.round(56+80*t),g=Math.round(217+30*t),b=Math.round(169-80*t);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
    let pad=i===0?1:2,rad=i===0?6:4;
    roundRect(s.x*C+pad,s.y*C+pad,C-pad*2,C-pad*2,rad);
    if(i===0){
      // eyes
      ctx.fillStyle='#0d1117';
      let ex=s.x*C+C/2+dir.x*4,ey=s.y*C+C/2+dir.y*4;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ex+dir.y*3,ey-dir.x*3,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ex-dir.y*3,ey+dir.x*3,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
  });

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#c9d1d9';ctx.font='bold 14px monospace';ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,12,8);
  ctx.fillStyle='#484f58';ctx.fillText('BEST '+best,W-80,8);

  if(state==='over'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,10,0.75)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e6edf3';ctx.font='bold 28px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8b949e';ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,W/2,H/2+10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff6b35';ctx.font='14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press any key to restart',W/2,H/2+44);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
}

function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);ctx.fill();
}

function keyHandler(e){
  let k=e.key;
  if(state==='over'){init();return}
  let map={'ArrowUp':{x:0,y:-1},'ArrowDown':{x:0,y:1},'ArrowLeft':{x:-1,y:0},'ArrowRight':{x:1,y:0},
           'w':{x:0,y:-1},'s':{x:0,y:1},'a':{x:-1,y:0},'d':{x:1,y:0},
           'W':{x:0,y:-1},'S':{x:0,y:1},'A':{x:-1,y:0},'D':{x:1,y:0}};
  let nd=map[k];
  if(nd&&!(nd.x===-dir.x&&nd.y===-dir.y)){nextDir=nd;e.preventDefault()}
}

document.addEventListener('keydown',keyHandler);
canvas.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>canvas.focus());
canvas.focus();

init();
let last=0;
function loop(ts){
  let dt=ts-last;last=ts;
  if(state==='play'){elapsed+=dt;if(elapsed>=speed){update();elapsed=0}}
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #111; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; background: #282c34; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
const W = c.width, H = c.height;
let state = 0, score = 0, lives = 3;
const pad = { w: 80, h: 12, x: 0, y: H - 40, spd: 6 };
const ball = { r: 6, x: 0, y: 0, dx: 0, dy: 0, spd: 5 };
const brick = { rows: 6, cols: 8, w: 0, h: 18, pad: 6, top: 50 };
brick.w = (W - (brick.cols + 1) * brick.pad) / brick.cols;
let bricks = [], keys = {};
const colors = ['#e06c75', '#d19a66', '#e5c07b', '#98c379', '#61afef', '#c678dd'];

function init() {
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  pad.x = (W - pad.w) / 2;
  ball.x = W / 2; ball.y = pad.y - ball.r;
  ball.dx = ball.spd * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1); ball.dy = -ball.spd;
  bricks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < brick.rows; i++) {
    bricks[i] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < brick.cols; j++) {
      bricks[i][j] = { x: brick.pad + j * (brick.w + brick.pad), y: brick.top + i * (brick.h + brick.pad), alive: 1 };
    }
  }
  state = 1;
}

function rect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r); ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
}

function update() {
  if (state !== 1) return;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) pad.x -= pad.spd;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) pad.x += pad.spd;
  pad.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - pad.w, pad.x));

  ball.x += ball.dx; ball.y += ball.dy;

  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.dx = Math.abs(ball.dx); ball.x = ball.r; }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.dx = -Math.abs(ball.dx); ball.x = W - ball.r; }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.dy = Math.abs(ball.dy); ball.y = ball.r; }

  if (ball.dy > 0 && ball.y + ball.r >= pad.y && ball.y + ball.r <= pad.y + pad.h + ball.spd && ball.x >= pad.x - ball.r && ball.x <= pad.x + pad.w + ball.r) {
    let hit = (ball.x - (pad.x + pad.w / 2)) / (pad.w / 2);
    ball.dx = hit * ball.spd * 1.2;
    ball.dy = -Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.1, ball.spd * ball.spd - ball.dx * ball.dx));
    ball.y = pad.y - ball.r;
  }

  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) { state = 2; } 
    else { ball.x = pad.x + pad.w / 2; ball.y = pad.y - ball.r; ball.dx = ball.spd * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1); ball.dy = -ball.spd; }
  }

  let alive = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < brick.rows; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < brick.cols; j++) {
      let b = bricks[i][j];
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      alive++;
      if (ball.x + ball.r > b.x && ball.x - ball.r < b.x + brick.w && ball.y + ball.r > b.y && ball.y - ball.r < b.y + brick.h) {
        b.alive = 0; alive--; score += 10;
        let ox = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + brick.w - (ball.x - ball.r));
        let oy = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + brick.h - (ball.y - ball.r));
        if (ox < oy) ball.dx *= -1; else ball.dy *= -1;
      }
    }
  }
  if (alive === 0) state = 3;
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#282c34'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf'; ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('BREAKOUT', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('Click or Space to Start', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
    return;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < brick.rows; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[i % colors.length];
    for (let j = 0; j < brick.cols; j++) {
      let b = bricks[i][j];
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      rect(b.x, b.y, brick.w, brick.h, 3); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf';
  rect(pad.x, pad.y, pad.w, pad.h, 4); ctx.fill();

  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e5c07b'; ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf'; ctx.font = '16px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 12, 30);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, W - 12, 30);

  if (state > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = state === 2 ? '#e06c75' : '#98c379';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(state === 2 ? 'GAME OVER' : 'YOU WIN!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf'; ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click or Space to Restart', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') && state !== 1) init(); });
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
c.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if (state === 1) pad.x = e.clientX - c.getBoundingClientRect().left - pad.w / 2; });
c.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); if (state === 1) pad.x = e.touches[0].clientX - c.getBoundingClientRect().left - pad.w / 2; }, { passive: false });
c.addEventListener('click', () => { if (state !== 1) init(); });

function loop() { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
